The '''Tithe Farm''' is a [[Farming]] based [[minigame]] that is located in [[Hosidius]], with {{SCP|Farming|34|link=yes}} required to play. The minigame revolves around intensively planting special seeds into farming patches, tending them until harvest, and depositing the produce into sacks in order to earn points. Players can speak to [[Farmer Gricoller]] for information on how to play.
